How to use Village A-Frame Cameroun

For future residents, investors and builders interested in an A-frame village in Cameroon's Littoral region, including members of the diaspora planning to return.

Getting started

1

Go to village-aframe-hub.lovable.app.

2

Click Découvrir les modèles to see each house with its specifications and budget.

3

Browse the gallery and the Expérience section.

4

5

STEPS

03Tips
  • Start the calculator with a conservative occupancy rate.
  • Budget the land and road access separately from the house.
  • The site is in French; you can write in French or English.
04FAQ
Where is the village?

A pilot site in the Littoral region of Cameroon.

Can I buy a single house?

Yes. Ask through the contact form; models and budgets are on the site.

To live in or to rent out?

Both. The calculator helps you compare.

Who builds?

A community of builders, described on the À propos page.
